subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Our Head of AI is hosting an exclusive fireside chat for AI leaders during CVPR with Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, Chief R&D officer at Nexar), followed by an intimate roundtable dinner - & we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at Moto Cucina - about a 15 min walk from the conference - on Saturday 14th June, starting at 6:30 PM. Would you be interested in joining?

subject: Anduril CVPR connect
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the recent raise! Will you be at the Anduril CVPR booth this
year?

I'd love to introduce myself in person. We work w/ many AI-driven
autonomous drone co's such as Skydio & Zipline who are developing very
similar computer vision models to Anduril for the purpose of object
detection, tracking etc. - I hope we can find time to connect.

For context, Encord is a computer vision ML DataOps platform (Series B,
$50m raised). The companies mentioned leverage our platform to improve
their model performance (via higher quality training data) & to speed up
their expansion into new use cases/environments through improved end-to-end
data pipeline automation & labelling efficiency (2-10x vs. in-house/first
gen tools) resulting in faster model iteration cycles.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives? We'll be at the
conference Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: Improving speed of video recognition model iteration cycles
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw the NBA partnership extension and the focus to scale annotation for multi-modal video recognition across large volumes of videos of different qualities, aspect ratios, manipulations. 

I've been working with a number of video AI teams at Twelve Labs, Synthesia, and WSC Sports to iterate their video recognition models faster. Working with such diverse content variation was a big annotation bottleneck for these teams, we helped to reducing annotation time and improving accuracy with better training workflows. 

Would you be up for a 20 min chat? I'd love to share what we're seeing from others in the space. I'm usually free Tues/Thursdays, but happy to find a time that works for you.

subject: Active learning & edge case discovery for logistics autonomy
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw the Airbus deployment of EZTow - a big milestone for autonomous logistics in industrial settings. 

As you expand TractEasy and EZTow into more complex environments, challenges around model generalization and perception robustness often come down to how efficiently teams can surface edge cases and iterate on training data. 

We're working with teams like Pickle Robot and Toyota-Woven to scale their CV workflows using active learning, automated QA, and evaluation tooling - helping them reduce annotation time while improving model reliability in deployment. 

Would you be open to a quick chat - happy to share what we're seeing across similar robotics stacks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.
